downloadFileCard.title: Receive Encrypted Files
downloadFileCard.description: Files are decrypted in your browser after download. No unencrypted data leaves your or sender's device.
downloadFileCard.waitingForUploadTitle: Waiting for sender to upload the file...
downloadFileCard.waitingForUploadDescription: The page will refresh automatically and notify you when the file is ready.
downloadFileCard.endToEndEncryptionNote: The file is decrypted locally in your browser. No one can read the content during transfer.
downloadFileCard.completedNote: File downloaded and decrypted! Check your downloads folder.

downloadPage.title: Receive Files
downloadPage.noSessionsDescription: Go back to the homepage to create a new session.
downloadPage.missingPrivateKeyDescription: Private key not found for this session. Cannot decrypt the file.

createSessionPage.title: Receive file
createSessionPage.description: Files are encrypted in your browser before upload. No unencrypted data leaves your device.

share.title: Share this link with the recipient
share.text: Use the link below to send me an encrypted file. The file is encrypted in your browser before sending, and decrypted locally on my device. No unencrypted data leaves your device.

createSessionPage.shareDescription: Share this link with the recipient to allow them to upload a file to this session. The file is encrypted in their browser before sending, and decrypted locally on your device. No unencrypted data leaves either of your devices.
createSessionPage.receiveNote: <1>Important:</1> The key to decrypt the file is stored locally in your browser. If your browser data is deleted, you will lose the key and cannot open the file uploaded by the sender. You will also not be able to download the file using a different browser than the one you are currently using. It is recommended to keep this page open until you have downloaded the file from the sender.

uploadFileCard.title: Send Encrypted Files
uploadFileCard.description: Files are encrypted in your browser before upload. No unencrypted data leaves your device.
uploadFileCard.shareLinkNote: Share this link with the recipient to allow them to download the file.
uploadFileCard.privateKeyNote: The private key is needed to decrypt the file. It is stored only in your browser's local storage.
